# publisher-commits-skip-ci

Publisher-created commits include '[skip ci]' in their message, which suppresses CI runs for these commits. This can cause changes from the publisher to bypass CI validation unexpectedly.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_publisher.py` — `tests.test_publisher.test_first_publish_creates_orphan_branch_and_pushes`
